### Checklist:
<!--
  Ensure you've done these tasks and either place a lowercase x between the [ ] brackets or click on the checkboxes after submitting

- [x] I am an example option that's been checked

-->
- [ ] I checked [on this page](https://github.com/Sv443/BetterYTM/issues?q=is%3Aissue+sort%3Aupdated-desc) if someone already reported the same bug
- [ ] I am using the latest version of BetterYTM (matching [the latest release](https://github.com/Sv443/BetterYTM/releases/latest))
- [ ] I am using a recent version of my browser
- [ ] I can reproduce the bug while <u>all</u> my other extensions and userscripts are disabled <!-- ignore if your issue is about compatibility with another extension or script -->
- [ ] I attached the console log to this issue


### Environment:
- Browser name & version: 
- Userscript version & build number: vX.X.X (#xxxxxxx)
- Userscript manager extension: 
<!--
  To view the userscript version and build number, either open the configuration menu and copy the numbers and letters in the "about" section,
  or open the JavaScript console of your browser (usually with Ctrl + Shift + K or F12) and scroll to the very top.
-->


### Description of the bug and steps to reproduce:
<!--
  Please write a clear and concise description of what the bug is and also include steps to reproduce it.
  Don't shy away from going into detail, it's much more helpful than having too little info.
-->


### Console log:
<!--
  In your userscript manager extension, there should be a menu of options for BetterYTM.
  Click the one labeled "Download console log file" and upload the file here.

  Alternatively, open the JavaScript console (usually with Ctrl + Shift + K or F12) and filter for the term "BetterYTM".
  Disable all kinds of errors except warnings and errors, expand every error that's collapsed, take a screenshot of them all and upload it here.
-->
